name: Direct Lighting for Volumes (Single Scattering)
aliases: Single Scattering via Light Source Importance Sampling
definition: Calculates the contribution to ray radiance from direct illumination (single scattering) by importance sampling light sources, solving the failure of brute-force scattering sampling for small light sources.
summary: Direct Lighting for Volumes uses light source importance sampling to efficiently calculate single scattering, avoiding the inefficiency of brute-force methods for small light sources.
